verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
When the sun is wrapped up,
And when the stars are obscured,
And when the mountains are made to move,
And when the she-camels, ten-month pregnant, are abandoned,
And when the beasts are gathered together,
And when the seas are made to flow forth one into the other,
w: are made to flow forth one into the other

verses.en: And when people are brought together,
And when the girl-child buried alive is questioned about,
‘For what crime was she killed?’
And when books are spread abroad.
And when the heaven is laid bare,
And when the Fire is caused to blaze up,
And when the Garden is brought nigh,
Then every soul will know what it has brought forward.
Nay! I call to witness the planets that recede,
Go ahead and then hide.
And I call to witness the night as it passes away,
w: and I call to witness the night

verses.en: And the dawn as it begins to breathe,
That this is surely the revealed word of a noble Messenger,

verses.ar: ذِیۡ قُوَّۃٍ عِنۡدَ ذِی الۡعَرۡشِ مَکِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۲۱﴾
verses.en: Possessor of power, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
Obeyed there, and faithful to his trust.
And your companion is not mad.
And he assuredly saw Him on the clear horizon.
And he is not niggardly with respect to the unseen.
Nor is this the word of Satan, the rejected.
Whither, then, are you going?
It is nothing but a Reminder unto all the worlds,
Unto such among you as desire to go straight,

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ یَّشَآءَ اللّٰہُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿٪۳۰﴾
verses.en: While you desire not a thing except that Allah, the Lord of the worlds, desires it.
